exams.notes: Applicant must be examined by the board according to the methods deemed most practical and expeditious to test qualifications.
exams.quote: must be examined by the board according to the methods deemed by it to be the most practical and expeditious to test the applicants' qualifications

interval_years.quote: the license of every person licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy in the State of Mississippi shall be renewed annually.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: submit it to the board in the manner prescribed by the board in the notice before June 30 with the renewal fee of an amount established by the board, but not to exceed Three Hundred Dollars ($300.00)

available.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure may grant license to practice medicine without examination as to learning to graduates in medicine or osteopathic medicine who hold license to practice medicine from another state, provided the requirements in such state are equal to those required by the State Board of Medical Licensure.

requirements.value: Licensure without examination available for out-of-state licensees if the other state's requirements are equal to Mississippi's. Also available for National Board of Medical Examiners diplomates, National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons diplomates, and Licentiates of the Medical Council of Canada from LCME-accredited Canadian medical schools. Military applicants and spouses subject to Section 73-50-1. Universal recognition available under Section 73-50-2 except for physicians under Section 73-25-1 et seq.
requirements.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure may grant license to practice medicine without examination as to learning to graduates in medicine or osteopathic medicine who hold license to practice medicine from another state, provided the requirements in such state are equal to those required by the State Board of Medical Licensure.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual personal use of narcotic drugs or other addiction-forming drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual personal use of narcotic drugs, or any other drug having addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual use of intoxicating liquors to extent affecting professional competency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual use of intoxicating liquors, or any beverage, to an extent which affects professional competency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing or prescribing narcotic drugs outside legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any narcotic drug, or any other drug having addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability otherwise than in the course of legitimate professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violation of federal or state drug law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution or use of any narcotic drug or any drug considered a controlled substance under state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or aiding in an abortion not medically indicated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring, or attempting to procure, or aiding in, an abortion that is not medically indicated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license by fraud or deception
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license by fraud or deception.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including false name, assisting unlicensed practice, fraudulent claims, deceptive documents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct, which includes, but is not limited to: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name or impersonating another practitioner, living or dead.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal, revocation, or restriction of license by another state's licensing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state or jurisdiction to issue or renew a license, permit or certificate to practice medicine in that jurisdiction or the revocation, suspension or other restriction imposed on a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrender of license or medical staff membership while under disciplinary investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Surrender of a license or authorization to practice medicine in another state or jurisdiction or surrender of membership on any medical staff or in any medical or professional association or society while under disciplinary investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final sanctions by HHS Office of Inspector General based on incompetency or gross misconduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Final sanctions imposed by the United States Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Inspector General or any successor federal agency or office, based upon a finding of incompetency, gross misconduct or failure to meet professionally recognized standards of health care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the board legally requested information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the board, its investigators or representatives information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the Medical Practice Act or board rules, orders, or agreements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision(s) of the Medical Practice Act or the rules and regulations of the board or of any order, stipulation or agreement with the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of deceptive advertisement provisions for health care practitioners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation(s) of the provisions of Sections 41-121-1 through 41-121-9 relating to deceptive advertisement by health care practitioners.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or inducing an abortion in violation of applicable statutory provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing or inducing an abortion on a woman in violation of any provision of Sections 41-41-131 through 41-41-145.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being out of compliance with an order for child support
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board shall be authorized to suspend the license of any licensee for being out of compliance with an order for support

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct, professional incompetency, or peer disciplinary action within professional associations or hospitals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct as defined in the physician licensure and disciplinary laws, pursuant to Section 73-25-29; Professional incompetency in the practice of medicine or surgery; or Having disciplinary action taken by his peers within any professional medical association or society

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill or safety due to mental illness, physical illness, or excessive drug/alcohol use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The license of any physician to practice medicine in this state shall be subject to restriction, suspension or revocation, as hereinafter provided, in case of inability of the licensee to practice medicine with reasonable skill or safety to patients by reason of one or more of the following: Mental illness; Physical illness, including but not limited to deterioration through the aging process, or loss of motor skill; Excessive use or abuse of drugs, including alcohol.

definition_quote.value: The practice of medicine shall mean to suggest, recommend, prescribe, or direct for the use of any person, any drug, medicine, appliance, or other agency, whether material or not material, for the cure, relief, or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body, or for the cure or relief of any wound or fracture or other bodily injury or deformity, or the practice of obstetrics or midwifery, after having received, or with the intent of receiving therefor, either directly or indirectly, any bonus, gift, profit or compensation
definition_quote.quote: The practice of medicine shall mean to suggest, recommend, prescribe, or direct for the use of any person, any drug, medicine, appliance, or other agency, whether material or not material, for the cure, relief, or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body, or for the cure or relief of any wound or fracture or other bodily injury or deformity, or the practice of obstetrics or midwifery, after having received, or with the intent of receiving therefor, either directly or indirectly, any bonus, gift, profit or compensation

methods_authorized.quote: to suggest, recommend, prescribe, or direct for the use of any person, any drug, medicine, appliance, or other agency, whether material or not material, for the cure, relief, or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body, or for the cure or relief of any wound or fracture or other bodily injury or deformity, or the practice of obstetrics or midwifery

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe, recommend, or direct the use of drugs and medicines as part of the practice of medicine. Telemedicine prescribing requires a license from the State Board of Medical Licensure. Temporary license holders in drug/alcohol treatment programs may not apply for DEA controlled substances registration.
drug_authority.quote: to suggest, recommend, prescribe, or direct for the use of any person, any drug, medicine, appliance, or other agency, whether material or not material, for the cure, relief, or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body

license_status_types.quote: the executive officer of the state board of medical licensure may issue under his signature a temporary license to practice medicine

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates may receive a limited institutional license for practice in Mississippi state institutions. Applicants must be graduates of foreign medical colleges approved by the National Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates, be employed or being considered for employment in a Mississippi state institution, and obtain majority recommendations from local medical society, State Medical Association district trustee, State Board of Medical Licensure district member, and institution board. License is limited to a particular institution, valid for one year, renewable annually, and limited to a maximum of five years (with exceptions). ECFMG certification required for transition to full license.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure is hereby authorized and empowered to grant limited institutional license for the practice of medicine in state institutions to graduates of foreign medical colleges approved by the National Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates or its successor

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Telemedicine (practice of medicine across state lines) requires a full Mississippi medical license unless: the evaluation/treatment/opinion is requested by a Mississippi-licensed physician AND that physician has already established a doctor-patient relationship with the patient.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The requirement of licensure as set forth in subsection (2) above shall not be required where the evaluation, treatment and/or the medical opinion to be rendered by a physician outside this state (a) is requested by a physician duly licensed to practice medicine in this state, and (b) the physician who has requested such evaluation, treatment and/or medical opinion has already established a doctor/patient relationship with the patient to be evaluated and/or treated.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: no person shall engage in the practice of medicine across state lines (telemedicine) in this state, hold himself out as qualified to do the same, or use any title, word or abbreviation to indicate to or induce others to believe that he is duly licensed to practice medicine across state lines in this state unless he has first obtained a license to do so from the State Board of Medical Licensure

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into by this state with any and all states legally joining in the Compact in accordance with its terms

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: anybody taking action as set forth in this paragraph shall report such action to the board within thirty (30) days of its occurrence.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: a portion of which fee shall be used to support a program to aid impaired physicians and osteopaths

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: If the examining committee, in its discretion, should deem an independent mental or physical examination of the physician necessary to its determination of the fitness of the physician to practice, the committee shall order the physician to submit to such examination.

investigational_drug_protection.quote: civil immunity shall apply to any licensed physician or licensed pharmacist who prescribes or makes recommendation to an eligible patient regarding prescription for or treatment with an investigational drug, biological product or device under the provisions of Section 41-131-1, and the State Board of Medical Licensure and/or the State Board of Pharmacy, as the case may be, shall be prohibited from taking any adverse action against the license of such physician or pharmacist based solely on the physician's action under the provisions of Section 41-131-1.
